key_reasoning.reason: New script_tool_calls package (authorizer, binding, context, exclusions, handler, workflow_resolution) plus the shared CodeMieTool base, script_result/http_result contracts, code-executor bridge and channel, toolkit registry, assistant and workspace services, and per-integration tools (Jira, Confluence, XWiki, GitLab, KB search).

Security-sensitive: per-tool authorization with assistant vs workflow scope, unknown-argument rejection, and a contextvar log filter installed on all handlers so tool arguments and results never reach logs. No exact precedent for the log-suppression filter; many error and edge cases (refusal codes, bad arguments, non-2xx replies, image responses) enumerated in tests.
45 files changed (about 26 source and config, 19 test files), 3542 insertions and 55 deletions, across src/codemie, src/codemie_tools, config and .gitlab.
Service, Infrastructure (code executor job bridge and channel, logging config, customer config), External (Jira, Confluence, XWiki, GitLab tool calls) and tool/API boundary; no schema or migration.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk at XL: security and authorization requirements (tool-call authorizer, log-leak guard, argument validation)
Component Scope at XL: touches core shared utility CodeMieTool and multiple tool integrations and workflows
Copy-paste replication not applicable: single repo (codemie)
